title: Completed TEAM MEMBER STATUS REPORT Data Contract
description: Additive structural schema validating completed TEAM MEMBER STATUS REPORT artifact data payloads (PMO-06.02).

activities_planned_this_reporting_period.description: Tasks and work packages scheduled for execution by this member during this period.

activities_accomplished_this_reporting_p.description: Tasks and work packages successfully finalized by this member during this period.

activities_planned_but_not_accomplished_.description: Scheduled tasks that were started but not completed or deferred.

root_cause_of_schedule_variances.description: Underlying reasons for any task delays or workload obstacles.

funds_planned_to_be_spent_this_reporting.description: Planned labor hours or direct expenses allocated for the member this period.

funds_spent_this_reporting_period.description: Actual labor hours or expenses incurred by the member during this period.

root_cause_of_cost_variances.description: Reasons for discrepancies between planned and actual resource expenditures.

quality_variances_identified_this_period.description: Defects, rework, or non-conformance issues encountered in deliverables.

planned_corrective_or_preventive_action.description: Targeted remedial steps to correct quality issues or prevent recurring defects.

activities_planned_for_next_reporting_pe.description: Upcoming work assignments and deliverables scheduled for the next interval.

costs_planned_for_next_reporting_period.description: Estimated hours or expenditures planned for the upcoming reporting period.

new_risks_identified.description: Potential technical, operational, or resource uncertainties identified by the member.

new_issues_identified.description: Immediate roadblocks, blockers, or dependencies requiring team resolution.

escalations.description: Impediments requiring intervention from the Project Manager or Team Lead.

decisions_made.description: Technical or operational choices adopted by the team member during execution.

lessons_learned_and_knowledge_transfer.description: Practical findings and best practices captured during task execution.

comments.description: Additional reflections, notes, or contextual feedback from the team member.
